{{Top|leg}}
'''Drevk''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Drevk kept several [[Cleaning droid/Legends|cleaning droids]] aboard their [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] to keep the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] clean. The smuggler found that it helped to deflect suspicion during [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] inspections.<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
